ns2:course.label: Res Studies in Animal Sciences
ns2:course.description: Directed and supervised study of selected research topics in Animal Sciences. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same or separate terms to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
